subject: Mutual action plan & PO path for NorthPeak GCP private offer
messages:
From: Jessica Tan <jessica@northpeak.ai>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-07-21T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Marketplace private offer (GCP) — MAP request

Hi Sergio,

Thanks for the demo last week. Procurement asked me to pull together a mutual action plan (MAP) so we can align on evaluation milestones and the GCP private offer path — specifically we need clarity on:

- Proposed evaluation timeline and acceptance gates (technical + business)
- Billing path: will NorthPeak be invoiced through GCP private offer or via Redwood invoice (we need details for our AP team)
- Contract / PO cadence and expected DocuSign flow
- Evidence we can present to our security review (SOC 2 + data residency notes)

I've attached our internal purchase requirements spreadsheet and the initial PO template. Can your team sketch a MAP with target dates? We are hoping to close by end of August if possible.

Thanks,
Jessica Tan
Sr. Procurement Manager
NorthPeak AI
(Attachment: northpeak_requirements.xlsx [xlsx])
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Jessica Tan <jessica@northpeak.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-07-22T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace private offer (GCP) — MAP request

Hi Jessica — great to hear from you, and glad the demo was helpful.

Attached is a draft MAP tailored to the GCP private offer route (redwood-map-northpeak-v1.pdf). High-level summary below:

1) Week 0 (Jul 23–29) — Kickoff & technical sandbox
   - Redwood provides a dedicated evaluation workspace (private deployment on GCP region us-west2)
   - Deliverables: sandbox credentials, sample prompts, latency/cost baseline

2) Week 1–2 (Jul 30–Aug 12) — Acceptance testing
   - Technical acceptance checklist: throughput test, ACLs, KV cache validation, model quality spot-checks
   - Security: share SOC 2 snapshot and data flow diagram (see attached redwood-soc2-cert.pdf)

3) Week 3 (Aug 13–19) — Commercial review & PO prep
   - Redwood provides private offer pricing and suggested billing path options (GCP private offer + invoice fallback)
   - We circulate PO draft and finalize billing contact (AP details)

4) Week 4 (Aug 20–26) — Contract sign & onboarding
   - DocuSign link for MSA + SOW, onboarding call scheduled within 48 hours of signature
   - Invoice issued per agreed path; if using GCP private offer, billing flows through Google and Redwood confirms settlement terms

We can accelerate some items by one week if NorthPeak is ready to accept a staged rollout (can start with a limited production shard).

Next steps: Laura (billing ops) and Karthik (private offers) are looped to confirm exact invoice mechanics and whether a Redwood invoice will be required in parallel. Jessica — if you can confirm your AP contact and preferred billing flow (GCP private offer vs Redwood invoice), we'll lock dates.

Attachments:
- redwood-map-northpeak-v1.pdf (MAP with milestone table)
- redwood-soc2-cert.pdf (SOC 2 summary)

Best,
Sergio Alvarez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
(Attachment: redwood-map-northpeak-v1.pdf [pdf])
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-07-27T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Marketplace private offer (GCP) — MAP request

Quick note from ops:

- If NorthPeak wants the GCP private offer, the typical path is for GCP to bill them directly (private pricing applied) and Redwood will reconcile usage for reporting. For AP teams that need a Redwood PO, we can issue a vendor invoice but that requires a short-term bridging agreement (we add billing metadata in the SOW).
- Action for Karthik: confirm whether we need to enable invoice issuance in parallel. Also call out any tax or remittance constraints (NorthPeak is US-based).

Karthik, can you capture the recommended invoice-side options and the lead time for setting up a Redwood vendor invoice if requested?

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Senior Manager, Enterprise Operations | Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>, Jessica Tan <jessica@northpeak.ai>
Date: 2027-07-28T11:12:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Marketplace private offer (GCP) — MAP request

Jessica — for clarity, two supported billing flows: 
1) GCP private offer (recommended) — NorthPeak is billed directly by GCP; Redwood provides usage and invoice reconciliation reports. No Redwood invoice required. Lead time: ~3 business days to provisioning the private offer once commercial terms are agreed.
2) Redwood vendor invoice — Redwood issues an invoice and collects payment; useful if your AP requires our vendor details. Lead time: ~5–7 business days to enable (we need W-9 + vendor setup).

If you expect PO-driven vendor invoices, please send the AP contact and remit address; I’ll kick off onboarding.

(Karthik)
Billing & Marketplace Ops | Redwood Inference
From: Jessica Tan <jessica@northpeak.ai>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>

Date: 2027-08-02T10:21:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace private offer (GCP) — MAP request

Thanks, team. GCP private offer is our preference — it keeps procurement simple. AP contact below:

- Anita Gomez, AP Manager — anita.gomez@northpeak.ai | +1-415-555-0134

Two asks before we can commit to the end-of-Aug timeline:
1) Can you confirm we can receive SOC 2 evidence and a short data residency statement in the same folder by Aug 6?
2) Michael (cc) wanted to confirm the evaluation parity: are we testing the same quantized model as in your hosted run, or will there be any configuration differences for the private offer?

On timelines: we can accept staged rollouts, but final PO needs to be on our desk by Aug 18 to meet finance closing.

—Jessica
